info.title: graph-cli
info.description: A .NET global tool for interacting with Microsoft Graph — manage emails, calendar events, Teams chats, To Do tasks, presence, user directory, and OneDrive/SharePoint files from the command line.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Microsoft Graph CLI - manage mail, calendar, chat, tasks, and more
